text:
alex: Quick sync — planning rollout for the 'pricing-tiered inference controls' feature. This is customer-visible tiering + automatic fallback to a cost-optimized model during overload. Goals: safe phased rollout, clear gates, and explicit enterprise opt-out.

sam: +1. Proposed canary sequence: 0.5% -> 3% -> 10% -> 50% -> 100% with 24–48h windows. Gating metrics: p95 latency, error rate, token-cost delta. Failure policy: if p95 > 2x baseline OR errors > 0.5% for 10m, trigger fallback to quantized-small or route to baseline model. Circuit-breaker: 2 infra incidents within 6h -> immediate rollback.

jordan: Implementation notes: we'll use a feature flag `pricing_tier_v1` and target by `customer_id` + region. A/B support via user buckets. Example rollout config we can push to flags service:

```json
{
  "flag": "pricing_tier_v1",
  "rules": [
    {"segment":"internal","pct":100},
    {"segment":"enterprise","pct":0},
    {"segment":"beta_us-east","pct":0.5},
    {"segment":"public_us-east","pct":0.5}
  ]
}
```

We can add an enterprise override `no_fallback=true` but that needs legal/app approval.

maria: Important: many enterprise contracts forbid silent fallback to a different model. We must add an opt-in/opt-out flag in Billing/Console and a contract checklist item. Also require a kill-switch in Console and an on-call alert integration with the runbook. Runbook steps should include `set flag pricing_tier_v1 -> 0` and `set enterprise_no_fallback -> true/false`.

deploy-bot: preflight results — load-test @ 5k RPS: OK; infra capacity checks: OK; security scan: minor secrets-lint warnings (fixed); smoke tests: passed. No blockers for initial canary.

alex: Good. Monitoring: build dashboard with p50/p95 token cost, p99 latency, error rate, model-fallback count, and enterprise-override count. Add customer-feedback webhook for quality regressions (e.g., hallucination or accuracy drops). Launch criteria proposal: 72h stable at 10% with no regressions, errors < 0.3%, token-cost delta < 10% vs baseline.

sam: Add auto-mitigation rules: if token-cost-delta > 20% and error rate within threshold, automatically cap tokens-per-request for non-enterprise traffic. Alerts: p95 > 800ms -> page SRE; p95 > 400ms -> page product on-call. Also log every fallback decision for audit.

jordan: I'll open a PR for flag config + A/B experiment hooks. Rollout checklist: 1) PR + code review, 2) QA run (smoke + regressions), 3) legal sign-off on enterprise override, 4) Console kill-switch + dashboard, 5) 2x 24h canaries, 6) ramp. Assigning: @jordan dev, @maria ops, @alex product, @sam SRE.

maria: I'll draft the runbook and ping Legal for the enterprise contract change. Also will prepare a quick Console toggle mock for PM review.

alex: Thanks — locking for next week's release window. I'll follow up with ticket links and PRs. :thumbsup:

(Notes: keep enterprise traffic out of fallback by default; make override auditable; ensure rollback is quick and observable.)
